metadata.question: Are there more than three lakes within a 50 km radius of coordinates (35.879797, 86.428836) in Augest 11, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (35.879797, 86.428836) with 50 km buffer radius - Date: August 11, 2024 (single date or narrow window) - Collection: Need water body detection - use Sentinel-2 NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or JRC Global Surface Water - Alternative: Use JRC Monthly Water History which has water classifications 2. Masking strategy: - For water detection via NDWI, mask clouds - Or use JRC which already has water classifications - Question is about lakes (water bodies), not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid zero: If we find 0-3 lakes (answer B), or >3 lakes (answer A) - C1: No imagery available for Aug 11, 2024 in that region - C2: Images exist but after processing, 0 valid pixels to detect water - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid result ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry and time const lon = 86.428836; const lat = 35.879797; const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]); const buffer = point.buffer(50000); // 50 km radius in meters const startDate = '2024-08-11'; const endDate = '2024-08-12'; // 2. Acquire Sentinel-2 data let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const imgCount = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 Images found: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { // Fallback: try Landsat 8 col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const imgCount2 = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat-8 Images found: ${imgCount2}`); if (imgCount2 === 0) { console.log('No imagery available for Aug 11, 2024'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Use first available image for water detection const img = col.first(); // Calculate NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) // NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) // For Sentinel-2: B3 (Green), B8 (NIR) const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Detect water (NDWI > 0.3 indicates water) const water = ndwi.gt(0.3); // 4. Count connected components (lakes/water bodies) // Mask water pixels const waterMasked = water.updateMask(water); // Count valid water pixels const pixelCount = waterMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const validPixels = await pixelCount.get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid water pixels: ${validPixels}`); if (validPixels === null || validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Identify individual lakes using connected components const connected = water.connectedComponents(ee.Kernel.plus(1), 256); const labeledWater = connected.updateMask(water); // Count number of unique lake objects const uniqueLakes = labeledWater.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const lakeCount = await uniqueLakes.get('labels').getInfo(); console.log(`Number of lakes detected: ${lakeCount}`); if (lakeCount === null || lakeCount === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Determine answer if (lakeCount > 3) { console.log(`Result: ${lakeCount} lakes > 3`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Result: ${lakeCount} lakes <= 3`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
